## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 8, 2026 - Aug 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Bluesdude55_, Aug 20, 2026, 1/5: "Poor and getting worse on Android...Sign in / Login issues everytime. Wasting too much time before being able to open app & start activity. No default setting retention. Auto Pause & type of activity setting should be set/forget similar to the Audio stat choice that remain checked or enabled. Actively looking for new app that works on the first launch. Purchase Information incorrect shows that I have over 400 days left on my subscription but using Free App Go version. don't recommend."
            2. _Mikołaj Ściobłowski_, Apr 8, 2026, 1/5: "Laughably bad programming. The voiceover will spam you with useless info instead of playing interval audio cues, a bug that was present FIVE YEARS ago. [08/04/26] The most poorly coded running app managed to get even worse, it doesn't even launch now, congrats ASICS."
            3. _Andre Brink_, Aug 25, 2026, 3/5: "usually good, but today it recorded only my time, no distance no pace, no commentary. so the app was running, my gps was on and still on after the run and showed 3 green bars before I started. And then they chose today to ask me to rate the app...... Another run, only time recorded. My app is broken."
